  General  [Commands]  Custom commands
  Browse built-in commands

  /bug [note]
    Report a bug to the team
  /clear
    Clear terminal and start a fresh session
  /compact
    Summarize the conversation to free up context
  /copy [N]
    Copy a response, code block, or ran command to the clipboard
  /create-plugin
    Create and validate a new native Muse plugin package in the current workspace. Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks to create a Muse plugin or invokes the create-plugin skill. Do NOT use for ap…
  /create-skill
    Create and validate a new Muse skill — project-local in the current workspace by default, or a personal skill staged for `muse skills install` into the managed personal root. Use ONLY when the us…
  /deep-research <question>
    Research a question across sources with cross-checking and citations
  /doctor
    Diagnose Muse Code product/runtime issues from installed binary evidence. Use ONLY when the user explicitly invokes the doctor skill, asks to debug/troubleshoot Muse Code itself, asks what happen…
  /effort [<none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max|ultra>]
    Set the model's effort level
  /export [transcript|trajectory]
    Save the conversation, or the full session log
  /feedback [note]
    Send quick feedback to the team
  /fork [prompt]
    Branch this session from the latest message
  /goal [<objective>|edit <objective>|clear|pause|resume]
    Start or manage continuous work toward a goal
  /grill
    Run an explicitly requested decision interview and record each settled decision in durable project documentation.
  /help
    Show help
  /hud
    Choose what appears in the bottom status bar
  /import <session-id-or-path>
    Import a Claude Code, Codex, or Grok session
  /init
    Explore the workspace and create or improve AGENTS.md
  /keymap
    Show keyboard shortcuts
⟩ /logout
    Log out, forget the saved login, and exit
  ↓ 29 more
  For CLI options: muse --help
  Esc to close
